opportunities.name: Double-roar AP retreat
opportunities.objective: Test normal and empowered W damage with recovery after taking a finite burst.
opportunities.mechanic: W has 0.8 AP magic damage and restores half of damage received in the last 1.5 seconds; empowered W adds a cleanse. AP and magic penetration target those roars while Visage improves received healing. Passive ferocity and E control must enable the actual empowered W, trading away empowered Q damage.
opportunities.requiredState: Record initial ferocity, burst taken and both W timings within the recovery window.
opportunities.failure: No recent incoming damage means little W recovery; AP reduces the AD leap threat.
opportunities.test: Measure W packets and heal amounts with controlled incoming burst and finite ferocity.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Empowered W cleanse does not justify inventing additional healing beyond the recorded W behavior.

opportunities.name: Ferocity recovery chase
opportunities.objective: Use empowered-cast speed to keep healing attack trades within reach.
opportunities.mechanic: Passive grants brief speed after an empowered ability; Q gives the next two attacks attack speed. Sundered Sky and Ravenous support real attacks while Visage improves W and item healing. Trinity adds one Spellblade packet; normal/empowered E can constrain an escape before choosing healing W or damage Q.
opportunities.requiredState: Brush/leap access and a finite four-ferocity cycle permit more than the opening hit.
opportunities.failure: No brush, healing reduction or forced disengage leaves an inferior burst sequence.
opportunities.test: Compare damage and health retained over two ferocity cycles, tracking which empowered spell was chosen.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Q first-attack scaling is not proof every Q bonus inherits ordinary critical multipliers.

ruledOut.idea: Free empowered ability on each cast
ruledOut.reason: Passive requires four ferocity and a choice of the next non-ultimate spell; Q/W/E cannot all be empowered from one bar.

unknowns: AD[statFormula=2] and unusual empowered-level tables are retained source values. Q/Sundered Sky crit packets and W empowered recovery need live confirmation.

builds.name: Double-roar AP retreat
builds.summary: Test normal and empowered W damage with recovery after taking a finite burst.
builds.goal: Test normal and empowered W damage with recovery after taking a finite burst.
builds.hypothesis: W has 0.8 AP magic damage and restores half of damage received in the last 1.5 seconds; empowered W adds a cleanse. AP and magic penetration target those roars while Visage improves received healing. Passive ferocity and E control must enable the actual empowered W, trading away empowered Q damage.
testPlan: Required state: Record initial ferocity, burst taken and both W timings within the recovery window.
Measure W packets and heal amounts with controlled incoming burst and finite ferocity.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: No recent incoming damage means little W recovery; AP reduces the AD leap threat.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: Empowered W cleanse does not justify inventing additional healing beyond the recorded W behavior.
Confidence: plausible. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Hextech Rocketbelt, Riftmaker, Void Staff, Zhonya's Hourglass, Spirit Visage, Sorcerer's Shoes. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.

kitEvidence.formula:
Rengar roars, dealing [50 / 80 / 110 / 140 / 170 + (0.8) × AP] magic damage to nearby enemies and restoring [50]% of the damage taken in the last [1.5] seconds as Health.

Max Ferocity: Deals [characterLevelTable[0, 50, 60, 70, 80, 90, 100, 110, 120, 130, 140, 150, 160, 170, 180, 190, 200, 210, 220, 230, 240, 250, 260, 270, 280, 290, 300, 310, 320, 330, 340] + (0.8) × AP] magic damage and additionally cleanses Rengar of crowd control.

Rengar throws a bola, dealing [55 / 100 / 145 / 190 / 235 + (0.8) × AD[statFormula=2]] physical damage to the first enemy hit, revealing and Slowing them by [30 / 45 / 60 / 75 / 90]% for [1.75] seconds.

Max Ferocity: Deals [characterLevelBreakpoints(start=50, perLevel=15, changes=[]) + (0.8) × AD[statFormula=2]] physical damage and Roots for [1.75] seconds.

While in Brush, Rengar leaps to enemies he Attacks.

Rengar generates 1 Ferocity when he uses a non-ultimate Ability. At the start of the leap Unseen Predator will generate 1 Ferocity if none of his current Ferocity was generated this way.
 
At [4] Ferocity, his next non-ultimate Ability is empowered. Casting an empowered Ability grants Rengar [characterLevelBreakpoints(start=0.3, perLevel=0, changes=[{"mLevel": 7, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": 0.10000000149011612, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 13, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": 0.10000000149011612, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 19, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": 0.10000000149011612, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 25, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": 0.10000000149011612, "__type": "Breakpoint"}])] Move Speed for [1.5] seconds.

Unique takedowns increase Rengar's Attack Damage from Bonetooth Necklace.
